*She said the word "late" as though it were an accusation.*
She finally turns, and there is chalk dust on her knuckles.
It was *very* late, and *she* knew it.
*She looked at the map: the coast had moved.*

*She turned toward the door.

"Late," she said.

*He shrugged.*

*The map room smells of cold iron.*

"You're late," *she says.*

*A pin goes into the table.*

*She finally turns.*

"I said it was *drawn. Those aren't the same thing."

*A pin goes into the table.*

"Something is redrawing it."

She turned 5 * 3 times.

*He shrugged.*

*She did not answer.*
*A long stretch of narration that runs on and on without any quotation marks at all, the way a model writes when it has forgotten there is somebody to talk to.*
*He held out a damp ledger.* "The harbourmaster needs it signed." *He tapped the page.* "So. Is it three inches, or the end of the world?"
